title: field-signal-cookbook-and-probe-recipes-nov-2025
summary: Concise synthesis of Q3–Q4 field signals grouped as "recipes" (cookbook style) for rapid experimentation and low-effort customer-facing patches. Intended as a living playbook for triage, quick prototyping, and handoff to product/engineering squads.
methodology: Pulled ~140 raw request threads from support, AE notes, and in-product feedback (Oct–Nov 2025). Clustered by friction patterns, then distilled into probe recipes that are scoped <= 5 dev-days. Emphasis on observable success criteria and rollback safety.
top_themes: Opaque cost spikes during stress bursts — customers lack token-level root cause
KV/prefix-cache invalidation confusion leading to high tail latency
Fallback model behavior not communicated — app UX shows abrupt response quality changes
Difficulty configuring autoscale burst limits across Dedicated pools
Fine-grained retry/fallback rules missing for chained tool-calling flows
request_catalog: cost-transparent-breakdowns: customers want per-route token-cost attribution in console and in API responses (low/med effort)
cache-visibility-endpoint: add an endpoint that returns KV cache hit/miss rates for a given key-prefix (med effort)
fallback-explain-mode: expose a telemetry flag that logs which fallback decision was used and why (low effort)
burst-config-wizards: UI wizards for configuring burst windows and safety caps on Dedicated pools (high effort)
toolchain-retry-policy-presets: prebuilt retry policies for common tool calling topologies (low effort)
prioritized_requests: P0: cache-visibility-endpoint — high impact on debugging tail latency; easy observability win for SREs and customers
P1: cost-transparent-breakdowns — strong sales ask for enterprise procurement and chargeback
P1: fallback-explain-mode — prevents dozens of duplicate CS tickets about sudden quality changes
P2: toolchain-retry-policy-presets — quick UX improvement for customers using run-time tooling
P3: burst-config-wizards — strategic but larger scope; coordinate with Dedicated roadmap
vignettes: Vignette A — Ad-ntech startup: noticed sudden 3x token cost over a weekend correlated with spike in long-context reranking. No route-level visibility; engineers took 2 days to find misrouted long-sequence calls.

Vignette B — Healthcare SaaS: prefix-cache invalidation during nightly sync caused 500ms tail latency increases for API calls; customer considered moving to Dedicated for isolation but would have solved with cache diagnostics.

Vignette C — Marketplace product team: rollout to smaller cohort caused fallback to base model and users reported hallucinations; CS couldn’t explain why fallback fired. They want a human-readable rationale in logs.
Vignette D — Platform team at an enterprise: configuring burst windows repeatedly misconfigured throughput and exceeded commit; they asked for guided defaults and safety caps in the Console UI

quick_probes: Probe 1 — Cache probe: instrument a 48-hour dataset to measure prefix hit-rate before/after a small TTL tweak; success: 20% increase in effective hit-rate without increased memory pressure
Probe 2 — Explain toggle: enable fallback-explain-mode for a single customer cohort for 1 week; success: reduction in 'why did this change' tickets by 60%
Probe 3 — Cost-router audit: run a sample of 5000 requests to check for unexpected longer-context routing; success: identify top 3 routes causing cost spikes

Probe 4 — Burst dry-run: provide a non-binding simulator in Console that predicts peak commit usage for a proposed burst window; success: 90% of previewed customers match simulator after real-world run
risk_flags: Privacy: cache-visibility must not expose customer payloads — implement key-only telemetry and strict RBAC
Telemetry volume: fallback-explain-mode could multiply logs; require sampling and retention caps
UX confusion: cost breakdowns could surface sensitive pricing data across teams — default to owner-only views
notes_for_product: Recommend shipping probe recipes as a 'Field Cookbook' page in the Console (read-only for customers) and an internal template for SE/CS. Include success metrics and quick rollback steps.
decisions_log: 2025-11-20: decided to scope cache-visibility to key-prefix stats not payloads (Asha M. + Connor L.)
2026-01-07: product agreed to mock cost-breakdown in Console with an 'owner-only' toggle for first release (Priya N.)
